applicabilityBasis.summary: Nest describes nTBILL as a vault token representing a share of a Treasury portfolio, with returns reinvested into the token price and redemptions processed as vault-share exits. That is tokenized fund or vault exposure, not a fixed-value payment stablecoin.

references.label: Nest available vaults: nTBILL share-token description
Nest nTBILL integration and redemption guide

genius.notes: nTBILL is a NAV-accreting Treasury vault share. It is explicitly assessed as an excluded security for this tracker because its value changes with underlying portfolio NAV and it represents a share of a vault rather than a GENIUS payment stablecoin.
